title: Test an AI invoice extractor before trusting the totals
audience_problem: A small business needs to detect invented invoice fields before records enter its workflow.
original_demo: Use three original synthetic invoices with missing fields, compare extracted JSON to a verified answer key, and reject unsupported claims.

title: Before buying workflow software: test export and permissions
audience_problem: Owners need a repeatable evaluation that checks data portability and access controls instead of feature hype.
original_demo: Export an original sample table, reopen it and compare fields; demonstrate denied access in a local test service.

title: Stop duplicate processing in a spreadsheet automation
audience_problem: Overlapping scheduled runs can process a business record twice unless concurrency is considered.
original_demo: Use a local reproduction with duplicate request IDs, show the failure, then test a lock and an explicit processed-record check.

title: Check suspicious business messages without clicking their links
audience_problem: An owner needs a clear verification routine for unexpected messages requesting money or account access.
original_demo: Use original fictional message examples, inspect sender and destination text, and verify the request through a separately obtained contact.

title: Before you automate approvals: test the one-cent boundary
audience_problem: An expense policy can fail at its exact threshold even when ordinary examples pass.
original_demo: Demonstrate the existing local approval app with travel at 100.00 and 100.01, then compare all three categories with an expected-result matrix.
